episode: The Scroll That Was Always Empty (Tai Lung)

beats.narration: He did everything to make his master proud
beats.caption: He did everything to make his master proud.
beats.action: youth lands a perfect kick, looks UP for approval; Shifu, back half-turned, gives nothing

beats.narration: He heard it far too late
beats.caption: He did everything to make his master proud. / He heard it far too late.
beats.action: his amber eye reflected in a gold surface, a tear line catching light
beats.lighting: gold glow from below, black around

beats.narration: In a valley where animals live by kung fu
beats.caption: He heard it far too late. / In a valley / where animals live by kung fu,
beats.action: morning mist over a valley of tiled roofs, peach trees, a mountain rising behind
beats.world_visual: 'a valley where animals live by kung fu' → the valley itself, wide, with villagers practising in the streets

beats.narration: masters train at the Jade Palace above the village
beats.caption: masters train at the Jade Palace, / above the village.
beats.action: the palace on the summit, a thousand steps climbing to it; figures training in the courtyard
beats.world_visual: 'masters train at the Jade Palace, above the village' → the palace on the summit, stairs, figures training

beats.narration: Inside waits the Dragon Scroll
beats.caption: above the village. / Inside waits the Dragon Scroll: limitless power,
beats.action: inside the hall: a scroll case high on a carved beam, light falling on it
beats.camera_move: slow push up toward the case
beats.world_visual: 'Inside waits the Dragon Scroll' → the scroll case high in the hall

beats.narration: limitless power for one chosen hero the Dragon Warrior
beats.caption: Inside waits the Dragon Scroll: limitless power, / for one chosen hero, the Dragon Warrior.
beats.action: golden light spills from the case; a single warrior silhouette forms in it
beats.world_visual: 'limitless power, for one chosen hero' → golden light forming one warrior silhouette

beats.narration: Master Shifu a red panda
beats.caption: for one chosen hero, the Dragon Warrior. / Master Shifu, a red panda,
beats.action: night: Shifu on the palace steps finds a bundle; a tiny cub inside

beats.narration: found a snow leopard cub on his steps and
beats.caption: Master Shifu, a red panda, / found a snow leopard cub on his steps, / and raised Tai Lung as a son.
beats.action: huge-eyed cub grabs Shifu's finger; Shifu's face softens

beats.narration: raised Tai Lung as a son
beats.caption: and raised Tai Lung as a son.
beats.action: Shifu ties a small cloth training wrap on the cub's paw

beats.narration: He trained him day and night sure he was the Dragon Warrior
beats.caption: and raised Tai Lung as a son. / He trained him day and night, / sure he was the Dragon Warrior.
beats.action: montage: cub → teen → youth, the same kata in the same spot, each faster

beats.narration: Every move was for his father's smile
beats.caption: sure he was the Dragon Warrior. / Every move was for his father's smile.
beats.action: youth lands the move, looks up; Shifu smiles and nods — Tai Lung glows

beats.narration: But the grand master Oogway an ancient tortoise
beats.caption: Every move was for his father's smile. / But the grand master, Oogway, an ancient tortoise,
beats.action: the ancient tortoise in the hall, leaning on his staff, slow head turn toward Tai Lung

beats.narration: saw darkness in him and refused
beats.caption: But the grand master, Oogway, an ancient tortoise, / saw darkness in him, and refused.
beats.action: Oogway's eyes narrow; Tai Lung's eager face falls

beats.narration: Shifu didn't fight that decision
beats.caption: Shifu didn't fight that decision.
beats.action: Tai Lung turns to Shifu for help; Shifu looks down, hands hidden in his sleeves

beats.narration: Tai Lung tore through the valley for the scroll
beats.caption: Tai Lung tore through the valley / for the scroll.
beats.action: night: a huge shadow tears through the village, lanterns fall, roofs break, silhouettes flee

beats.narration: Shifu couldn't bring himself to hurt him
beats.caption: Shifu couldn't bring himself to hurt him.
beats.action: Shifu in fighting stance; his paw raised; it trembles and lowers

beats.narration: Oogway stopped him
beats.caption: Shifu couldn't bring himself to hurt him. / Oogway stopped him.
beats.action: a calm finger touch; Tai Lung freezes mid-leap and falls

beats.narration: Twenty years in chains in a mountain prison
beats.caption: Oogway stopped him. / Twenty years in chains, / in a mountain prison, blaming his father.
beats.action: inside a mountain prison: chained to a stone ring; the iron cuff sits over the old training wrap

beats.narration: blaming his father
beats.caption: in a mountain prison, blaming his father.
beats.action: his eyes in the dark, breath steaming, jaw tight

beats.narration: He escaped and came home for the scroll
beats.caption: in a mountain prison, blaming his father. / He escaped, and came home for the scroll,
beats.action: chains burst; he runs up a rope bridge toward a cave mouth of daylight

beats.narration: and for an answer
beats.caption: He escaped, and came home for the scroll, / and for an answer.
beats.action: at the foot of the palace stairs, he looks up — same framing as the cub
beats.purpose: home, the mirror of the beginning

beats.narration: He beat his old master down
beats.caption: and for an answer. / He beat his old master down,
beats.action: impact: Shifu thrown into a pillar, it cracks (cut on impact)

beats.narration: roaring that everything was to make him proud
beats.caption: roaring that everything was to make him proud.
beats.action: standing over him, roaring, eyes wet

beats.narration: And Shifu finally said it he'd always been proud
beats.caption: roaring that everything was to make him proud. / And Shifu finally said it: / he'd always been proud.
beats.action: on the floor, Shifu looks up and finally meets his eyes; he speaks

beats.narration: His pride had blinded him
beats.caption: he'd always been proud. / His pride had blinded him.
beats.action: memory flash: Shifu's hand on the cub's head, smiling — then back to the old face

beats.narration: Tai Lung didn't stop He took the scroll
beats.caption: Tai Lung didn't stop. / He took the scroll, and opened it.
beats.action: he turns away from his father and takes the scroll

beats.narration: and opened it
beats.caption: He took the scroll, and opened it.
beats.action: he unrolls it; gold light floods his face

beats.narration: It was blank A golden surface
beats.caption: It was blank. / A golden surface, reflecting his own face.
beats.action: the scroll: blank, a polished gold surface

beats.narration: reflecting his own face
beats.caption: A golden surface, reflecting his own face.
beats.action: in the gold: his own face, confused, the anger draining

beats.narration: That explains his rage It doesn't excuse the harm
beats.caption: That explains his rage. / It doesn't excuse the harm.
beats.action: quiet: the broken village from the old rampage, a lantern rocking; villagers rebuilding

beats.narration: He spent his life trying to make his father proud He never had to
beats.caption: He spent his life trying / to make his father proud. / He never had to.
beats.action: the open scroll on the floor; beside it the frayed training wrap; Shifu's small hand reaches and closes over it. Hold. Fade.
beats.environment: hall, dust in a light shaft
beats.purpose: he never had to earn it
